verdict.rationale: Undermind documents written syntheses with a ranked paper list, Markdown reports with linked citations, custom tables, iterating on reports, and shared workspaces for collaborating. A community user also describes a results page with a named section. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sectioned report structure, export or sharing formats for stakeholders outside the workspace (PDF/doc/link), and independent corroboration of the table and summary output.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders

citations.quote: produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis
Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace. Citations link back to the source papers
Generate custom tables to support your research.
Iterate on reports, dive into full texts, extract details, and refine your understanding.
